reviewer_pack.selection: After first-linkage-supported groups are frozen: 32-record core selected deterministically without extractor results, plus at most 8 separately flagged prespecified challenge records. Challenge sampling may use frozen text-complexity or candidate flags but never effect estimates or post-review outcomes.
minimum_fields: original source text made available only to authorized human reviewer
reviewer_pack.blinding: Initial pack shows original source evidence and reviewer fields only; it omits extractor predictions, model judgments, evidence spans and aggregate results until labels are locked.
reviewer_pack.release_rule: User or RA human review is confirmed. Lock initial labels before any extractor comparison. Do not reopen the heldout 400 or count model judgments as human labels.

preparation_scope: This delegated attachment prepares and locally validates commands; overall execution and cluster submission are authorized and scheduled by the root execution plan.

No Revelio movement or result claims
No historical-text or causal interpretation of CREATED
